sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B - GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: lued/Qwen3.8-27B-AEON-UNCENSORED-INT8-W8A16-MTP · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: An abliterated, Ampere-optimized quantization for dual RTX 3090 inference. Base model · Qwen3.8-27B · Sibling quantization · abliterix · vLLM · llm-compressor This is a numerical W8A16 quantization of AEON-7/Qwen3.8-27B-AEON-ULTIMATE-UNCENSORED-BF16, an abliterated (uncensored) version of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27B vision-language model for coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks, with configurable reasoning and a native 262K-token context window.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B (2026): The Complete Guide to Qwen's New 27B Vision ...
sources.snippet: The complete 2026 guide to Qwen3.8-27B — Qwen's new 27B dense vision-language model with DeepSWE 42.2, Terminal Bench 73.0, OSWorld 84.3, native image/video input, 262K context, and Apache 2.0 weights.
